summary: The audit checks MS&E 302 and the courses of one research path (Computational Social Science, Decision and Risk Analysis, Operations Research, Organizations, Technology and Entrepreneurship, Policy and Strategy, or Quantitative Finance), each letter graded when a letter grade is offered, and 135 units of graduate work. Checked by hand: three years of full-time study, 3 units with each of four faculty members before candidacy, aligning with an advisor by the end of your second year, the second-year rotations or tutorials, the candidacy, progress and reading committee forms, 30 units a year with the annual review, the 3.4 GPA in MS&E courses, the qualification paper or project, the area exam or research defense, the faculty vote to advance to candidacy, the oral exam and the dissertation. Up to 45 units from another institution may transfer if you do not finish a Stanford master's.

program.why: "The PhD requires a minimum of 135 units, up to 45 units of which may be transferred from another graduate program." The Bulletin's program minimum says 90.

ziPxGxYm-text.why: The overview restates the area depth courses, the first-year seminar, the qualification procedure, the oral exam and the dissertation, which are rules here, and the 135 units, now the program minimum. What it adds is checked by hand: "The program requires a minimum of three years of full-time graduate study." "Before candidacy, at least three units of work must be taken with each of four Stanford faculty members." "PhD students who do not align with an advisor by the end of the second year at Stanford are subject to dismissal from the program." Second-year students must "Complete at least two one-quarter research rotations or tutorials, or one two-quarter research rotation, tutorial, or research paper or project" and "Submit a candidacy form"; third-year students "Submit a progress form listing the dissertation topic"; fourth-year students "submit the reading committee form"; each year "Complete 30 units" (in the fourth year "30 dissertation units"), and "Each doctoral student's progress is reviewed annually by the MS&E faculty."
